falsifier: Equal facts with normalized roles fail to improve program correctness over the frozen ordinary outputs, or static inspection finds a missing visible fact.

arms: visible-only normalized-role prompt versus frozen ordinary prompt

missing_condition: At least two ordinary natural failures must remain after the strongest simple visible-only controls; observed residual is zero.

scoring.primary: exact structured program and deterministic value

visible_transformation: Preserve every raw table/header/question fact; add only transparent canonical roles derived from visible text: period axis, named-row axis, section axis, named-entity axis, and aggregation scope.
